headline: Rajani Associates acts on Ravita Engineering Services ₹116 crore IPO

detail: Ravita Engineering Services Limited has raised ₹116.05 crore from an initial public offering of equity shares. Rajani Associates advised Ravita Engineering Services as well as the book running lead manager Vivro Financial Services Private Limited on this IPO. The Firm's scope of work included conducting legal and secretarial diligence; preparing and finalizing responses to queries raised by the NSE; preparing and finalizing all ancillary documents and all agreements; and drafting, reviewing and finalizing all chapters of the DRHP, RHP and Prospectus. The transaction was led by Sangeeta Lakhi (Senior Partner), with support from Associates Sommya Khandelwal and Addvit Shrivastava.
